an1.268:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṃkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.268:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṃkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.269:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṃkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.269:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṃkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.270:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.270:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.271:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.271:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.272:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.272:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.273:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.273:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.274:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppādeyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.274:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppādeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.275:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo saṃghaṃ bhindeyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.275:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano saṃghaṃ bhindeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.276:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.276:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
an1.277:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve arahanto sammāsambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.277:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā eko arahaṃ sammāsambuddho uppajjeyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
